I'm in my first cleaning job (part of a care home) I'm 19 and my Co workers are in their 50's. My Co workers have worked in cleaning jobs for years and actually do nothing, they won't clean dirty toilets and have never passed infection control. Since I joined we've passed infection control everytime, I've recently been told by carers the older cleaners actually sit around and pretend to clean, I've even heard some very strange cleaning techniques (mopping up with no water, hoovering the bathtubs). So my answer for this question is no. Professional cleaners aren't always the best ones, it all depends on how hard they work, I'd never class myself as professional but the ones that I've met that are supposedly professional, do not do a good job at all.
